recipe.variant: Qwen-Image-2512 bf16 + qwen-360-diffusion 2512 v2 LoRA (1.0), 2048x1024 equirectangular, 50 steps, cfg 4, empty negative
recipe.from_template: templates_text_prompt_to_360hdr.app.json (the generation half; its SeedVR2 3B upscale is the seedvr2 family's upscale-image recipe as the next stage)

prompt.note: start with 'equirectangular 360 image, ' (the template's prefix; card triggers: 'equirectangular', '360 image', '360 panorama'), then the scene and its medium/style

negative.note: the official 2512 negative (verbatim, without the trailing full stop as the template has it)

shift.note: 3-3.1 in every template; 'Increase the shift if you get too many blurry/dark/bad images. Decrease if you want to try increasing detail.'

recipe.defaults_note: A 360 equirectangular panorama: the left edge joins the right, top and bottom are the poles. Card: 2:1 at 2048x1024 for best results (other 2:1 sizes 'may cause the model to struggle with proper horizons'); name the medium/style (photograph, oil painting, illustration); for people say head/face and footwear. Upscale after (seedvr2) for a skybox. The template runs bf16 - the card warns fp8_e4m3fn transformers give grid artifacts with this LoRA.
